name: productive-youtube
description: Transform YouTube into a productivity tool - Block distractions and stay focused

scripts.build: vite build && npm run build:content && npm run copy-files
scripts.build:content: vite build --mode content_script && vite build --mode chatgpt_automation && vite build --mode gemini_automation && vite build --mode claude_automation && vite build --mode grok_automation
scripts.package: npm run build && zip -r extension.zip dist/*
